Blacksburg mixes small-town feel with a spirited college environment, and has become a beautiful escape from the bustle of the big city while still providing plenty for residents to do. Virginia Tech is Blacksburg’s biggest attraction. The historic university brings in more than 30,000 students and a slew of dining and entertainment options along with it. Taphouses and cafes line University City Blvd. and North Main St., and there’s a plethora of small businesses and shops that supply students and families alike. Blacksburg’s charming atmosphere is amplified by the quaint homes and apartments that fill the modest, tree-lined streets. Virginia’s scenic beauty creates a host of outdoor destinations all around Blacksburg. Countless hiking trails lie just outside your rental, all easily accessed thanks to US-460. sections.subMarketSection: City - Blacksburg Blacksburg is nestled between the Cherokee National Forest and Jefferson National Forest, creating a scenic surround for this lively college town. Blacksburg mixes small-town feel with a spirited college environment, and has become a beautiful escape from the bustle of the big city while still providing plenty for residents to do. Virginia Tech is Blacksburg’s biggest attraction. The historic university brings in more than 30,000 students and a slew of dining and entertainment options along with it. Taphouses and cafes line University City Blvd. and North Main St., and there’s a plethora of small businesses and shops that supply students and families alike. Blacksburg’s charming atmosphere is amplified by the quaint homes and apartments that fill the modest, tree-lined streets. Virginia’s scenic beauty creates a host of outdoor destinations all around Blacksburg. Countless hiking trails lie just outside your rental, all easily accessed thanks to US-460. sections.subMarketSection: City - Blacksburg Blacksburg is nestled between the Cherokee National Forest and Jefferson National Forest, creating a scenic surround for this lively college town. Blacksburg mixes small-town feel with a spirited college environment, and has become a beautiful escape from the bustle of the big city while still providing plenty for residents to do. Virginia Tech is Blacksburg’s biggest attraction. The historic university brings in more than 30,000 students and a slew of dining and entertainment options along with it. Taphouses and cafes line University City Blvd. and North Main St., and there’s a plethora of small businesses and shops that supply students and families alike. Blacksburg’s charming atmosphere is amplified by the quaint homes and apartments that fill the modest, tree-lined streets. Virginia’s scenic beauty creates a host of outdoor destinations all around Blacksburg. Countless hiking trails lie just outside your rental, all easily accessed thanks to US-460. Learn more about living in Blacksburg

They may be used by those companies to build a profile of your interests and show you relevant adverts on other sites. They do not store directly personal information, but are based on uniquely identifying your browser and internet device. If you do not allow these cookies, you will experience less targeted advertising.

sections.subMarketSection: City - Blacksburg Blacksburg is nestled between the Cherokee National Forest and Jefferson National Forest, creating a scenic surround for this lively college town. Blacksburg mixes small-town feel with a spirited college environment, and has become a beautiful escape from the bustle of the big city while still providing plenty for residents to do. Virginia Tech is Blacksburg’s biggest attraction. The historic university brings in more than 30,000 students and a slew of dining and entertainment options along with it. Taphouses and cafes line University City Blvd. and North Main St., and there’s a plethora of small businesses and shops that supply students and families alike. Blacksburg’s charming atmosphere is amplified by the quaint homes and apartments that fill the modest, tree-lined streets. Virginia’s scenic beauty creates a host of outdoor destinations all around Blacksburg. Countless hiking trails lie just outside your rental, all easily accessed thanks to US-460. Learn more about living in Blacksburg

sections.subMarketSection: City - Blacksburg Blacksburg is nestled between the Cherokee National Forest and Jefferson National Forest, creating a scenic surround for this lively college town. Blacksburg mixes small-town feel with a spirited college environment, and has become a beautiful escape from the bustle of the big city while still providing plenty for residents to do. Virginia Tech is Blacksburg’s biggest attraction. The historic university brings in more than 30,000 students and a slew of dining and entertainment options along with it. Taphouses and cafes line University City Blvd. and North Main St., and there’s a plethora of small businesses and shops that supply students and families alike. Blacksburg’s charming atmosphere is amplified by the quaint homes and apartments that fill the modest, tree-lined streets. Virginia’s scenic beauty creates a host of outdoor destinations all around Blacksburg. Countless hiking trails lie just outside your rental, all easily accessed thanks to US-460. sections.subMarketSection: City - Blacksburg Blacksburg is nestled between the Cherokee National Forest and Jefferson National Forest, creating a scenic surround for this lively college town. Blacksburg mixes small-town feel with a spirited college environment, and has become a beautiful escape from the bustle of the big city while still providing plenty for residents to do. Virginia Tech is Blacksburg’s biggest attraction. The historic university brings in more than 30,000 students and a slew of dining and entertainment options along with it. Taphouses and cafes line University City Blvd. and North Main St., and there’s a plethora of small businesses and shops that supply students and families alike. Blacksburg’s charming atmosphere is amplified by the quaint homes and apartments that fill the modest, tree-lined streets. Virginia’s scenic beauty creates a host of outdoor destinations all around Blacksburg. Countless hiking trails lie just outside your rental, all easily accessed thanks to US-460. Learn more about living in Blacksburg

sections.subMarketSection: City - Blacksburg Blacksburg is nestled between the Cherokee National Forest and Jefferson National Forest, creating a scenic surround for this lively college town. Blacksburg mixes small-town feel with a spirited college environment, and has become a beautiful escape from the bustle of the big city while still providing plenty for residents to do. Virginia Tech is Blacksburg’s biggest attraction. The historic university brings in more than 30,000 students and a slew of dining and entertainment options along with it. Taphouses and cafes line University City Blvd. and North Main St., and there’s a plethora of small businesses and shops that supply students and families alike. Blacksburg’s charming atmosphere is amplified by the quaint homes and apartments that fill the modest, tree-lined streets. Virginia’s scenic beauty creates a host of outdoor destinations all around Blacksburg. Countless hiking trails lie just outside your rental, all easily accessed thanks to US-460. Learn more about living in Blacksburg

sections.subMarketSection: City - Blacksburg Blacksburg is nestled between the Cherokee National Forest and Jefferson National Forest, creating a scenic surround for this lively college town. Blacksburg mixes small-town feel with a spirited college environment, and has become a beautiful escape from the bustle of the big city while still providing plenty for residents to do. Virginia Tech is Blacksburg’s biggest attraction. The historic university brings in more than 30,000 students and a slew of dining and entertainment options along with it. Taphouses and cafes line University City Blvd. and North Main St., and there’s a plethora of small businesses and shops that supply students and families alike. Blacksburg’s charming atmosphere is amplified by the quaint homes and apartments that fill the modest, tree-lined streets. Virginia’s scenic beauty creates a host of outdoor destinations all around Blacksburg. Countless hiking trails lie just outside your rental, all easily accessed thanks to US-460. Learn more about living in Blacksburg

sections.subMarketSection: City - Blacksburg Blacksburg is nestled between the Cherokee National Forest and Jefferson National Forest, creating a scenic surround for this lively college town. Blacksburg mixes small-town feel with a spirited college environment, and has become a beautiful escape from the bustle of the big city while still providing plenty for residents to do. Virginia Tech is Blacksburg’s biggest attraction. The historic university brings in more than 30,000 students and a slew of dining and entertainment options along with it. Taphouses and cafes line University City Blvd. and North Main St., and there’s a plethora of small businesses and shops that supply students and families alike. Blacksburg’s charming atmosphere is amplified by the quaint homes and apartments that fill the modest, tree-lined streets. Virginia’s scenic beauty creates a host of outdoor destinations all around Blacksburg. Countless hiking trails lie just outside your rental, all easily accessed thanks to US-460. Learn more about living in Blacksburg

sections.subMarketSection: City - Blacksburg Blacksburg is nestled between the Cherokee National Forest and Jefferson National Forest, creating a scenic surround for this lively college town. Blacksburg mixes small-town feel with a spirited college environment, and has become a beautiful escape from the bustle of the big city while still providing plenty for residents to do. Virginia Tech is Blacksburg’s biggest attraction. The historic university brings in more than 30,000 students and a slew of dining and entertainment options along with it. Taphouses and cafes line University City Blvd. and North Main St., and there’s a plethora of small businesses and shops that supply students and families alike. Blacksburg’s charming atmosphere is amplified by the quaint homes and apartments that fill the modest, tree-lined streets. Virginia’s scenic beauty creates a host of outdoor destinations all around Blacksburg. Countless hiking trails lie just outside your rental, all easily accessed thanks to US-460. sections.subMarketSection: City - Blacksburg Blacksburg is nestled between the Cherokee National Forest and Jefferson National Forest, creating a scenic surround for this lively college town. Blacksburg mixes small-town feel with a spirited college environment, and has become a beautiful escape from the bustle of the big city while still providing plenty for residents to do. Virginia Tech is Blacksburg’s biggest attraction. The historic university brings in more than 30,000 students and a slew of dining and entertainment options along with it. Taphouses and cafes line University City Blvd. and North Main St., and there’s a plethora of small businesses and shops that supply students and families alike. Blacksburg’s charming atmosphere is amplified by the quaint homes and apartments that fill the modest, tree-lined streets. Virginia’s scenic beauty creates a host of outdoor destinations all around Blacksburg. Countless hiking trails lie just outside your rental, all easily accessed thanks to US-460. Learn more about living in Blacksburg

Blacksburg mixes small-town feel with a spirited college environment, and has become a beautiful escape from the bustle of the big city while still providing plenty for residents to do. Virginia Tech is Blacksburg’s biggest attraction. The historic university brings in more than 30,000 students and a slew of dining and entertainment options along with it. sections.subMarketSection: City - Blacksburg Blacksburg is nestled between the Cherokee National Forest and Jefferson National Forest, creating a scenic surround for this lively college town. Blacksburg mixes small-town feel with a spirited college environment, and has become a beautiful escape from the bustle of the big city while still providing plenty for residents to do. Virginia Tech is Blacksburg’s biggest attraction. The historic university brings in more than 30,000 students and a slew of dining and entertainment options along with it. Taphouses and cafes line University City Blvd. and North Main St., and there’s a plethora of small businesses and shops that supply students and families alike. Blacksburg’s charming atmosphere is amplified by the quaint homes and apartments that fill the modest, tree-lined streets. Virginia’s scenic beauty creates a host of outdoor destinations all around Blacksburg. Countless hiking trails lie just outside your rental, all easily accessed thanks to US-460. sections.subMarketSection: City - Blacksburg Blacksburg is nestled between the Cherokee National Forest and Jefferson National Forest, creating a scenic surround for this lively college town. Blacksburg mixes small-town feel with a spirited college environment, and has become a beautiful escape from the bustle of the big city while still providing plenty for residents to do. Virginia Tech is Blacksburg’s biggest attraction. The historic university brings in more than 30,000 students and a slew of dining and entertainment options along with it. Taphouses and cafes line University City Blvd. and North Main St., and there’s a plethora of small businesses and shops that supply students and families alike. Blacksburg’s charming atmosphere is amplified by the quaint homes and apartments that fill the modest, tree-lined streets. Virginia’s scenic beauty creates a host of outdoor destinations all around Blacksburg. Countless hiking trails lie just outside your rental, all easily accessed thanks to US-460. Blacksburg mixes small-town feel with a spirited college environment, and has become a beautiful escape from the bustle of the big city while still providing plenty for residents to do. Virginia Tech is Blacksburg’s biggest attraction. The historic university brings in more than 30,000 students and a slew of dining and entertainment options along with it. Taphouses and cafes line University City Blvd. and North Main St., and there’s a plethora of small businesses and shops that supply students and families alike. Blacksburg’s charming atmosphere is amplified by the quaint homes and apartments that fill the modest, tree-lined streets. Virginia’s scenic beauty creates a host of outdoor destinations all around Blacksburg. Countless hiking trails lie just outside your rental, all easily accessed thanks to US-460. Learn more about living in Blacksburg

Vote review helpful Flag Review Feb. 6, 2020 Unexpected rent increases Through almost a year living at Foxridge Apartments my room mate and I had no issue at all with the management. This changed when we indicated that we were interested in resigning our lease early into the school year (around October). Foxridge didn't present a new lease to us until after winter break and increased our rent without any notification besides that on the lease. It seems very unprofessional for a company to surprise good tenants (who are also students without a notable income) by sneaking in price increases late into the apartment hunting season, which severely limited any other option. Property Manager Responded Feb. 13, 2020 Read More 2 People Found This Helpful Was this helpful? Vote review helpful Flag Review Aug. 21, 2019 READ BEFORE YOU CONSIDER FOXRIDGE First of all the office is extremely unhelpful and rude. They have hung up on me and rarely answer the phones at all. Maybe they technically have a security, but nothing is done. I have seen cars keyed, ive been hit by a car on the sidewalk outside my building, and parked cars hit and run. Our entire building had many packages stolen (I lived on the third floor) and even laundry taken from washing machines. Their only response was to send a letter out informing people. We already knew packages were getting stolen. They made no actual effort to make their residences feel more safe. The thefts never stopped. The maintenance workers are super nice and helpful, which are the only people who care about you. Ive lived there for two and a half years. Even though Virginia law states they are not allowed to charge for normal wear and tear, they consider only scratches on the wall to be normal wear and tear. They dont consider light bulbs to be wear and tear, which legally it is (trust me I checked.) But we are students and obviously cant take them to court. The carpet second year, my dog chewed up in the corner. Totally needed to be changed and I accepted that charge. But expect to lose your entire deposit and possible even pay them more. Both apartments I lived in had rats and bats in the walls. I could hear them moving around in the ceiling often, even after they use their exterminator. They recently changed the washing machines by letting you pay on your phone. They didn't change the actual machines that have put holes in lots of clothes. They then made it .75 more to use each machine, even if you use quarters. Now its 1.50 for each machine. Year one, they charged us to change the carpets even though they hadnt been changed in years and nothing was done to them besides walking on it. They charged us for the carpet because they hadnt been changed in years and were changing them in every unit. They will charge you at any chance they can and still have the nerve to treat you badly. They dont care about their tenants just money. Its so unfortunate that its run by these people because the building, property, and bus system was great. But because of who its run by, the quality of living is crappy. No matter how much you clean, no matter how long/ how much effort you put to reach their standards; it wont matter. They will charge you anyways. I spent hours bleaching and scrubbing the bathroom and still was charged. Choose more wisely then I did. Property Manager Responded Aug. 26, 2019 Read More 7 People Found This Helpful Was this helpful? Vote review helpful Flag Review Sept. 8, 2016 Be aware of move out charges I lived in this apartment community for 19 months and I moved out on Sunday and they did not do inspection while I was there because it's a holiday and then I was surprised to see some the charges they deducted and they will politely deny everything you say to encounter the charges and they do not keep any proofs of apartment condition when you move in apart from the inspection sheet that you fill up when you move in. So, I am sure lot of students will be moving into this apartment but be aware and keep note of following, - Do not move in or move out on holidays. (they expect you to move out on weekdays if you want to have the inspection even though they will charge you for weekends or holidays if your move-out falls in that). So, best bet for you is to have move-out date on lease agreement as one of the week days. - Make sure to take pictures of apartments (each and every single stuff) and also when you move out. This is very helpful when you are dealing with this kind people. - Fill out move-in inspection sheet in detail assuming you are moving into a brand new apartment (even though it's over 40 years old apartment community). There will be lots of things which may not be available as checklist but do write them all. (e.g. use finger to see if air vent is clean, use hand to see if bathtub, wash basin, kitchen basin, kitchen floor, etc are not sticky and write them if it's, make sure to write even if there is a single spot in carpet). These carpets are freaking at least 10 years old, but they will charge you if you have not written anything on inspection sheet. Management is pathetic, rude. I will never ever live in this community if I happen to come to Blacksburg again and even won't recommend. "Dollar Tree will return your dollar even if you lose your receipts but Foxridge/Heathwood management won't. Leasing office people are so terrible." If you do not allow these cookies, you will experience less targeted advertising.

Blacksburg mixes small-town feel with a spirited college environment, and has become a beautiful escape from the bustle of the big city while still providing plenty for residents to do. Virginia Tech is Blacksburg’s biggest attraction. The historic university brings in more than 30,000 students and a slew of dining and entertainment options along with it. Our prime location offers convenience along with easy transportation options, as we are situated on the Blacksburg Transit Bus Route. sections.subMarketSection: City - Blacksburg Blacksburg is nestled between the Cherokee National Forest and Jefferson National Forest, creating a scenic surround for this lively college town. Blacksburg mixes small-town feel with a spirited college environment, and has become a beautiful escape from the bustle of the big city while still providing plenty for residents to do. Virginia Tech is Blacksburg’s biggest attraction. The historic university brings in more than 30,000 students and a slew of dining and entertainment options along with it. Taphouses and cafes line University City Blvd. and North Main St., and there’s a plethora of small businesses and shops that supply students and families alike. Blacksburg’s charming atmosphere is amplified by the quaint homes and apartments that fill the modest, tree-lined streets. Virginia’s scenic beauty creates a host of outdoor destinations all around Blacksburg. Countless hiking trails lie just outside your rental, all easily accessed thanks to US-460. Learn more about living in Blacksburg

sections.subMarketSection: City - Blacksburg Blacksburg is nestled between the Cherokee National Forest and Jefferson National Forest, creating a scenic surround for this lively college town. Blacksburg mixes small-town feel with a spirited college environment, and has become a beautiful escape from the bustle of the big city while still providing plenty for residents to do. Virginia Tech is Blacksburg’s biggest attraction. The historic university brings in more than 30,000 students and a slew of dining and entertainment options along with it. Taphouses and cafes line University City Blvd. and North Main St., and there’s a plethora of small businesses and shops that supply students and families alike. Blacksburg’s charming atmosphere is amplified by the quaint homes and apartments that fill the modest, tree-lined streets. Virginia’s scenic beauty creates a host of outdoor destinations all around Blacksburg. Countless hiking trails lie just outside your rental, all easily accessed thanks to US-460. Learn more about living in Blacksburg

As the hero George remarks in A Room with a View, "We have a view!" Our balcony overlooks the mountain range surrounding our area. In the fall, the trees on the mountains burst into a symphony of color. We often eat dinner on our balcony, just to watch the sunset. And after all, what other reason to move to southwest Virginia than to experience the beauty of nature? We also have a 24-hour gym, gorgeously landscaped pool, and ample parking in our complex. Management was very responsive to our requests for apartment upgrades when we moved in, and we're thrilled with the state of our place! Windsor Hills is close enough to downtown to allow easy access to restaurants and shopping and far enough away from the hubbub to be peaceful and quiet on weekends (the complex is located in a residential area just at the edge of a rural stretch of land). The best part is that there is a "time check" bus station steps from our door that goes directly to Virginia Tech campus for a no-hassle workday. sections.reviewsSection: Property Ratings at Windsor Hills Apartments How Is This Rating Determined? 5.0 Excellent Out of 5 5.0 Blended Score 3 Renter Reviews Share details of your own experience with this property Write a Review Sort By Most Recent Aug. 16, 2015 Incredible View Want an incredible vista of the mountains around Blacksburg? As the hero George remarks in A Room with a View, "We have a view!" Our balcony overlooks the mountain range surrounding our area. In the fall, the trees on the mountains burst into a symphony of color. We often eat dinner on our balcony, just to watch the sunset. And after all, what other reason to move to southwest Virginia than to experience the beauty of nature? We also have a 24-hour gym, gorgeously landscaped pool, and ample parking in our complex. Management was very responsive to our requests for apartment upgrades when we moved in, and we're thrilled with the state of our place! Windsor Hills is close enough to downtown to allow easy access to restaurants and shopping and far enough away from the hubbub to be peaceful and quiet on weekends (the complex is located in a residential area just at the edge of a rural stretch of land). The best part is that there is a "time check" bus station steps from our door that goes directly to Virginia Tech campus for a no-hassle workday. Read More 8 People Found This Helpful Was this helpful? Vote review helpful Flag Review July 31, 2015 Windsor Hills Nice fairly large apartments for a good price. It can sometimes be hard to find a 2 person apartment for the same price per person as a 4 person but Windsor Hills does a good job, I pay just over $400 a month. Also Windsor Hills is very dog friendly with a dog park and location wise it is one of the best in terms of only having to take one bus that goes directly through downtown and to campus. Can't argue that places like the Edge or downtown apartments are significantly more higher end but the prices are a completely different class and honestly a working college student just can't afford it without significant contributions from a parent. sections.subMarketSection: City - Blacksburg Blacksburg is nestled between the Cherokee National Forest and Jefferson National Forest, creating a scenic surround for this lively college town. Blacksburg mixes small-town feel with a spirited college environment, and has become a beautiful escape from the bustle of the big city while still providing plenty for residents to do. Virginia Tech is Blacksburg’s biggest attraction. The historic university brings in more than 30,000 students and a slew of dining and entertainment options along with it. Taphouses and cafes line University City Blvd. and North Main St., and there’s a plethora of small businesses and shops that supply students and families alike. Blacksburg’s charming atmosphere is amplified by the quaint homes and apartments that fill the modest, tree-lined streets. Virginia’s scenic beauty creates a host of outdoor destinations all around Blacksburg. Countless hiking trails lie just outside your rental, all easily accessed thanks to US-460. Learn more about living in Blacksburg

sections.subMarketSection: City - Blacksburg Blacksburg is nestled between the Cherokee National Forest and Jefferson National Forest, creating a scenic surround for this lively college town. Blacksburg mixes small-town feel with a spirited college environment, and has become a beautiful escape from the bustle of the big city while still providing plenty for residents to do. Virginia Tech is Blacksburg’s biggest attraction. The historic university brings in more than 30,000 students and a slew of dining and entertainment options along with it. Taphouses and cafes line University City Blvd. and North Main St., and there’s a plethora of small businesses and shops that supply students and families alike. Blacksburg’s charming atmosphere is amplified by the quaint homes and apartments that fill the modest, tree-lined streets. Virginia’s scenic beauty creates a host of outdoor destinations all around Blacksburg. Countless hiking trails lie just outside your rental, all easily accessed thanks to US-460. Learn more about living in Blacksburg

sections.reviewsSection: Property Ratings at Smiths Landing Apartments How Is This Rating Determined? 5.0 Excellent Out of 5 5.0 Blended Score 2 Renter Reviews Share details of your own experience with this property Write a Review Sort By Most Recent May 6, 2024 Meh They don't do anything if you have noisy neighbors there are no "quiet hours". Additionally if you aren't signed up for the trash service when you move in, don't sign up at all. Your trash will not be picked up and you'll be paying $20+ for nothing. If you try and cancel like they claim you can the rental office will tell you that you can't because all of a sudden your fee covers the lot fee for the dumpsters??? Not to mention that trash will not be picked up at 9pm like they tell you, it will be pick up 12am if your lucky (mostly likely not at all) and your neighbors' guest will throw their personal trash in your can. Complaints are ignored as much as possible. Maintenance is really nice and services are provided quickly. The apartment it's self is good besides some of the doors not installed properly. It's close to campus and the ADT app lets you lock/unlock your doors while you're away. It's not a bad place but if they are going to ignore you anyways there are cheaper closer to campus places to consider. Property Manager Responded May 7, 2024 Read More Was this helpful? sections.subMarketSection: City - Blacksburg Blacksburg is nestled between the Cherokee National Forest and Jefferson National Forest, creating a scenic surround for this lively college town. Blacksburg mixes small-town feel with a spirited college environment, and has become a beautiful escape from the bustle of the big city while still providing plenty for residents to do. Virginia Tech is Blacksburg’s biggest attraction. The historic university brings in more than 30,000 students and a slew of dining and entertainment options along with it. Taphouses and cafes line University City Blvd. and North Main St., and there’s a plethora of small businesses and shops that supply students and families alike. Blacksburg’s charming atmosphere is amplified by the quaint homes and apartments that fill the modest, tree-lined streets. Virginia’s scenic beauty creates a host of outdoor destinations all around Blacksburg. Countless hiking trails lie just outside your rental, all easily accessed thanks to US-460. Learn more about living in Blacksburg
